message.content:
The Premier League’s all‑time assists record belongs to **Ryan Giggs** (Wales), who finished his career with **162 assists**.  

If you’re looking for the *current* season’s top assist provider, the 2023/24 Premier League leaders were:

| Season | Player | Team | Assists |
|--------|--------|------|---------|
| 2023/24 | **Kevin De Bruyne** | Manchester City | 15 |

(These figures are up to date as of the end of the 2023/24 campaign.)
